WD14TaggerPlus.description: WD-series image tagger. Supports ONNX (auto-adapting NHWC/NCHW) and safetensors + timm community models. Caches the ONNX session and reports the device actually used.

model.name: model
model.tooltip:
Two formats are auto-detected, no conversion needed:
  - ONNX (.onnx + tag csv): adapts NHWC / NCHW automatically
  - safetensors + timm (<name>/model.safetensors + config.json): community models
Entries marked with a download arrow are fetched on first use (official source first, then mirror).

threshold.name: threshold
threshold.tooltip: General tag threshold (upstream default 0.35). Some community models need more, e.g. canary recommends 0.61.

character_threshold.name: character_threshold
character_threshold.tooltip: Character tag threshold (upstream default 0.85). Align it when comparing against another node.

device.name: device
device.tooltip: auto uses CUDA when available; a failed load falls back and is reported in the device output.

replace_underscore.name: replace_underscore
replace_underscore.tooltip: Turn blue_eyes into blue eyes. Note downstream classifiers that split on whitespace.

escape_parens.name: escape_parens
escape_parens.tooltip: Upstream escapes ( ) into \( \); disabling keeps tag lookups working downstream.

sort_by_confidence.name: sort_by_confidence
sort_by_confidence.tooltip: On: sort by confidence, highest first. Off: vocabulary order, same as upstream.

exclude_tags.name: exclude_tags
exclude_tags.tooltip: Comma separated tags to exclude, case-insensitive.

preprocess.name: preprocess
preprocess.tooltip: Framing for community models. auto/pad resizes the long side and pads to a square (keeps the whole image, recommended); crop resizes the short side and centre-crops.

color_order.name: color_order
color_order.tooltip: Channel order. auto is BGR, the WD-series convention. If colour tags look wrong (e.g. blonde hair tagged blue_hair), try rgb.

PixAITaggerPlus.description: PixAI Tagger v1.0. Models are picked from a dropdown of the ComfyUI models directory instead of a hand-typed path.

model.name: model
model.tooltip: Scanned from ComfyUI/models/pixai_tagger/. Entries marked with a download arrow are fetched on first use.

threshold_mode.name: threshold_mode
threshold_mode.tooltip: custom uses the six thresholds below; optimal_calibrated uses the model's per-tag calibrated thresholds and ignores them.

config_override.name: config_override
config_override.tooltip: Usually left on auto. Only needed when a directory contains several config.json files.
